products.name: Photoroom
products.note: AI photo editing; background removal; e-commerce focus; EU data handling

profile_text.body:
Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing tool and listing studio founded in 2019, designed primarily for e-commerce businesses and social media creators. The company describes itself as enabling users to create product and portrait pictures using only a phone, and offers features including background removal, background replacement, object removal, clothing recoloring, image resizing, and AI-generated shadows. It also offers tools it labels as Product Staging, Ghost Mannequin, Flat Lay, Product Beautifier, and a Product Video Generator, among others.

For larger organizations, Photoroom offers custom AI models, API access, batch editing, bulk background removal, bulk resizing, and bulk positioning under what it calls a catalogue-scale visual production offering. The company states its background removal tool is trusted by 80 million or more users, and a customer quoted on its site describes six-figures savings and a reduction of workload to a quarter through automation. An MCP server is listed among its current offerings. The held facts record Photoroom's product as focused on AI photo editing, background removal, e-commerce use, and EU data handling, with no litigation on file.
